architecture.summary: A serverless social platform using Hono on Cloudflare Workers. Frontend is built with Vite, utilizing Cloudflare Static Assets for global delivery. Data persistence via Cloudflare D1 (SQL-based relational storage) handles Users, Posts, Comments, and DMs. Cloudflare KV serves as a session/fingerprint cache and global rate limiter to prevent spam.
techDecisions: Use Hono's Zod Validator for type-safe request parsing.
Implement D1 for relational database operations; run migrations via 'wrangler d1 migrations apply'.
Use Browser Fingerprint (via hash of user agent + screen resolution) stored in KV for ephemeral session identification.
Adopt Cursor-based pagination (using timestamp or ID) for efficient Feed and DM queries.
Frontend SPA architecture with React Query for efficient data fetching and caching.

ambiguities.title: Auth Mechanism Definition
ambiguities.detail: Browser fingerprinting is insufficient for persistence if the browser clears storage or cache, and it lacks security against spoofing.
ambiguities.clarificationSuggestion: Use browser fingerprint as a session identity (deviceId) but implement JWT signed by Workers to track user context; clarify if user accounts require persistent identity.

ambiguities.title: Feed Flow Ordering and Pagination
ambiguities.detail: No specification on feed ordering (chronological vs. algorithmic) or pagination strategy (cursor vs. offset).
ambiguities.clarificationSuggestion: Assume reverse chronological order and cursor-based pagination for performance.

ambiguities.title: Direct Message Scope
ambiguities.detail: Direct messages imply a P2P or multi-user chat feature, which requires a relational schema for message threads.
ambiguities.clarificationSuggestion: Define if it is 1-on-1 private messaging or public-reply-based threads.

apiContracts.responseSchema: { posts: Array<{id: string, content: string, user_id: string}>, next_cursor: string }

coverageNotes: 接口测试覆盖全部 3 个公开契约端点（POST /api/v1/posts、GET /api/v1/feed、POST /api/v1/messages）的正常流及已定义异常码（400_INVALID_CONTENT、401_UNAUTHORIZED、404_USER_NOT_FOUND）。
E2E 测试覆盖浏览器指纹无感登录场景下的核心用户路径：首页 Feed 流加载、发布文字动态并实时回显、以及站内信交互入口可达性验证。
契约边界说明：500_DB_ERROR 需在数据库故障注入或 Mock 环境下验证；当前公开契约未包含独立的评论（Comments）接口定义，待补充评论 API 契约后可进一步扩展评论接口与持久化断言。

qaCritic.reviewSummary: 初版测试集覆盖了基础正向路径与部分契约错误码，但存在明显盲区：1）缺少空白字符、超长文本及非法分页等边界校验；2）私信 API 正向用例强依赖已有 Feed 数据，空库时会静默跳过；3）完全缺失 XSS 注入与伪造/空指纹头安全测试；4）UI 测试中私信流程未执行真实提交与报错断言，且缺少双击防重、空输入拦截、500 异常恢复及刷新会话保持；5）缺少并发发帖竞态测试。本次加固已将上述盲区全部补齐并转化为可执行断言。

findings.issue: POST /api/v1/posts 与 POST /api/v1/messages 缺少纯空白字符串、缺字段及超长文本校验，且私信接口未覆盖未认证(401)与空消息体(400)场景。
findings.recommendation: 补充空白字符、缺失字段、超长载荷测试用例，并在私信接口中显式校验无指纹返回 401 及空内容返回 400。

findings.issue: POST /api/v1/messages 正向用例在 Feed 为空时会直接跳过，导致核心链路漏测；GET /api/v1/feed 缺少极限 limit 分页边界与空结果游标测试。
findings.recommendation: 在私信测试前先通过发帖接口造数确保存在合法 user_id，并增加 limit=1 最小分页与超界 cursor 校验。

findings.issue: 未覆盖社区高频的 XSS 脚本注入风险（发帖与私信内容包含 script 或 onerror 事件载荷），且未测试空字符串/纯空白浏览器指纹头。
findings.recommendation: 增加 XSS 载荷端到端测试，监听 dialog 事件并校验 DOM 未执行恶意脚本；同时测试空指纹头返回 401。

findings.issue: UI 私信测试仅检查表单元素可见而未实际提交；同时缺失双击防重/加载态校验、空输入拦截、500 接口异常恢复及页面刷新后指纹持久化验证。
findings.recommendation: 补全私信表单提交与错误提示断言，利用路由拦截模拟 500_DB_ERROR 验证 UI 降级恢复，并校验发帖防重与刷新持久化。

findings.issue: 缺少同一浏览器指纹并发发帖测试，无法暴露高并发下的 ID 冲突、数据覆盖或数据库锁异常。
findings.recommendation: 使用 Promise.all 并发发起 5 个发帖请求，断言全部成功且返回的 post id 互不重复。
